tools.title: KiCad 10.0.6 (PCB checks, fabrication export, schematic net extraction)
tools.size_note: Compressed linux/amd64 layers plus config from the registry manifest; installed size is the unpacked image on disk.
capabilities: recorded KiCad 5-9 board/schematic format upgrade to KiCad 10 (derivative bundle)
fixed-layer Gerber X2 and circular Excellon export
schematic export and net extraction (XML, version E)
tools.rights: KiCad is GPL-3.0-or-later; library and notice terms stay in the image under /usr/share/doc.
tools.qualification: Synthetic original fixtures only; older KiCad 5-9 boards only through the recorded upgrade derivative; linux/arm64, ERC/parity and assembly outputs are unverified.

tools.title: AVR GCC 5.4.0 (baremetal C11 firmware compile, atmega328p ABI)
tools.size_note: Built locally from toolpacks/firmware/Dockerfile on a pinned Debian base; the package download happens at build time and its size is not recorded. A rebuild produces a different image ID that must be re-pinned here.
capabilities: firmware compile to ELF32 AVR and Intel HEX (C only, explicit atmega328p ABI)
no flashing, device access or hardware compatibility claim
tools.rights: GCC and binutils are GPL; avr-libc is BSD-style. Notices stay in the image under /usr/share/doc.
tools.qualification: Synthetic C fixtures only; other ABIs, languages, PlatformIO and linux/arm64 are unsupported.

tools.title: PrusaSlicer 2.5.0 (optional FDM slicing of exact frozen print preparations)
tools.size_note: Not built or measured by this release. Built locally from toolpacks/slicer/Dockerfile on the same pinned Debian bookworm base as the firmware pack; the package download happens at build time and neither its size nor the installed image size has been measured. The resulting image ID is installation-specific: record it as the digest of each approved slicer recipe.
capabilities: FDM G-code export from an STL, OBJ or 3MF mesh with declared profile settings, orientation, supports and copies
prepared 3MF project export without slicer estimates
no printer connection, submission or control
tools.rights: PrusaSlicer is AGPL-3.0-or-later; Debian package copyright notices stay in the image under /usr/share/doc. Generated outputs carry the rights derived from the staged source bundle.
tools.qualification: Unverified: no actual image build or slicing run is recorded for this release. Resin/SLA output, STEP import, linux/arm64, printability and physical qualification are not established.
